# AWS Certified Widget Specialist

Validate your skills with the shelves and crates of Amazon Widget Store.

## Exam overview

AWS Certified Widget Specialist

### Category

Specialty

### Exam duration

130 minutes

### Exam format

65 questions; either multiple choice or multiple response

### Testing options

Pearson VUE testing center or online proctored exam

### Languages offered

English
French (France)
Japanese
Korean
Portuguese (Brazil)
Simplified Chinese

## Prepare for the exam

Read the Amazon Widget Store user guide before you schedule the exam.
